title: Clarify stage-local launcher output and contradictory saved stages
outcome: Clarify stage-local launcher output and contradictory saved stages
acceptance: The launcher docs and regression tests explicitly distinguish per-stage success from an overall FAIL caused by input drift; the overall verdict remains decisive for run success and source-identity validation remains a separate host requirement.

Saved passed stages with a missing/nonzero exit, an error or counted failures do not present an unqualified passed stage line; targeted tests cover these shapes without weakening overall verdict checks.

completion.summary: Landed launcher stage-local normalization and matching bounded diagnostic inspection, with regression coverage preserving overall input-drift verdicts and saved artifacts.
